title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.30986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior--policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. translated_title: 通过瞬时轨迹分布匹配强化扩散模型
translated_abstract: 前向扩散强化学习（RL）——无需轨迹反向传播即可实现确定性ODE采样——在高效对齐扩散模型方面日益流行。然而，我们揭示出现有方法本质上依赖于带符号的奖励加权回归（RWR），即将可训练策略的速度回归到来自行为分布的采样轨迹上。无偏基线减除隐含地假设策略速度等于行为边际速度——这是一个理想化的假设，在无分类器引导（CFG）采样、离线/离策略更新以及不完美的在线自一致性情况下会被违反。这种行为-策略失配破坏了基线不变性，并注入了由基线引起的梯度漂移，导致训练不稳定。为解决这一问题，我们提出了瞬时轨迹分布匹配（iTDM）……
tldr: 该论文揭示现有前向扩散强化学习方法因行为分布与策略失配导致基线引起的梯度漂移和训练不稳定，并提出瞬时轨迹分布匹配（iTDM）来解决这一问题，从而高效对齐扩散模型。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that existing forward diffusion RL methods suffer from behavior-policy mismatch that causes baseline-induced gradient drift and unstable training, and proposes Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching (iTDM) to resolve this issue for efficient diffusion model alignment.
